intro: Portland's only in-town public bathhouse is Washington Baths on the East End, a walk-in-only spot with gender-separate saunas and a shared courtyard with hot and cold pools. The rest of the area's drop-in options are small wood-fired community saunas and a campground Nordic spa within about 20-25 minutes of downtown, in Scarborough and Freeport, where you book a seat in a shared session. Several mobile operators work the southern Maine coast seasonally; Village Sauna in South Portland was temporarily closed as of 2026-11-24 while it looks for a winter site.

venues.name: Washington Baths
venues.session_length: No time limit (venue says a typical visit lasts 1.5-2 hours)
venues.cold_plunge: Outdoor cold pool (50F) in a shared courtyard, plus a 104F hot pool
venues.schedule: Thursday-Monday 12pm-9pm, last entry 8pm. Walk-in only, no reservations; in-person waitlist when full. Silence observed on Fridays. Gender-separate, clothing-optional sauna rooms; bathing suits required in common areas. Monthly Queer Community Day with all-gender bathing. Closed Nov 26-27 (Thanksgiving) and Dec 22-25, 2026.
venues.notes: Saunas use a traditional thermal-mass stove (kiuas) that can be fired with wood or gas; water may be poured on the rocks. Venue lists sauna air at roughly 180-200F. 44 lockers, lounge and library, small cafe; no outside food or drink. Bring a swimsuit, towel and sandals (towel rental $3, free sandals). Groups are discouraged; keep groups to 5 or fewer.

venues.name: ROVE Sauna
venues.neighborhood: Scarborough (Black Point Rd, about 15 minutes south of Portland)
venues.address: 134 Black Point Rd, Scarborough, ME (behind Black Point Surf Shop)
venues.session_length: 60 minutes (three ~15-minute heat rounds with cool-down breaks)
venues.cold_plunge: No plunge; cold-water bucket for cooling off
venues.schedule: Shared sessions of up to 8 guests; book all 8 spots for a private session. Online booking recommended; walk-ups welcome when space allows. Session times Unknown (shown on the booking page). Swimwear required. Operates rain or shine.
venues.notes: Hosted sessions with essential oils added to the water poured on the stones (scent-free on request). Venue says earlier sessions run milder and later sessions hotter. Cubbies for belongings; towels, water and electrolytes sold on site; bathroom in the surf shop during its opening hours. Cancellations more than 24 hours ahead are refunded.

venues.name: Timberstone Sauna
venues.neighborhood: Freeport (Wolfe's Neck Center, about 20 miles north of Portland)
venues.address: Wolfe's Neck Center, 184 Burnett Road, Freeport, ME
venues.drop_in_price: $32 per person for a 1-hour spot in a public session; private group session $275 (up to 9 people)
venues.session_length: 60 minutes (book two consecutive sessions for 2 hours)
venues.schedule: By reservation only; reservations must be made at least 12 hours ahead. Booking page says it is typically open on weekends during high tide, with the schedule posted about 2 weeks in advance. Season opened Saturday, October 3. Shared with other guests; bathing suit or equivalent clothing required.
venues.notes: Mobile sauna parked on the oceanside just after the bridge onto the Wolfe's Neck Center campus (a nonprofit farm with trails). Small changing area inside. Bring a towel to sit on and water. Cancellations more than 24 hours ahead are refunded minus processing fees.

venues.name: Unwind Nordic Spa
venues.neighborhood: Freeport (Desert of Maine Campground, about 20 minutes north of Portland)
venues.drop_in_price: $55 weekdays; $75 Friday from 1pm, Saturday and Sunday; $85 on a few holiday dates; $10 off 8am starts; 5-visit pass $275
venues.cold_plunge: None open as of 2026-11-24: the plunge pool is heated to the mid-90s F as a warm soak, and an individual cold plunge is installed but awaiting State of Maine approval
venues.schedule: Open year-round, daily 8am-9:45pm. Adults 21+. Book a day and arrival window online; everyone signs a waiver and gets a gate code. Not limited to campground guests.
venues.notes: Group cedar Nordic sauna seating about 12 (water for steam), a 104F salt-water stone hot tub seating about eight, lounge chairs and a fire pit under a pergola. Heat source Unknown. Change and shower in the campground Bath House just outside the gate. Free cancellation up to the day before.
